subject.title: Feature request: MEMORY.md size warning/limit enforcement

question: Should OpenClaw add core Control UI save-time `MEMORY.md` budget enforcement and archive UX, or limit this issue to existing diagnostics plus the broader bounded-memory design?
rationale: Current main already warns and diagnoses bootstrap truncation, but the remaining request changes the workspace-file editing UX and memory lifecycle rather than repairing one broken code path.

options.title: Define Narrow Core UX Contract
options.body: Add a Control UI budget display and explicit save-time warning or refusal for bootstrap files, while leaving auto-archive to a separate memory design.

options.title: Fold Into Bounded Memory Work
options.body: Track hard limits and archive behavior in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/42877 and treat this issue as diagnostics-only after maintainer confirmation.

options.title: Review Diagnostics PR Separately
options.body: Use the open fork PR only for extra `/status` or edit-error diagnostics and avoid calling it the complete fix for this issue.

recommendation.title: Define Narrow Core UX Contract
recommendation.body: Add a Control UI budget display and explicit save-time warning or refusal for bootstrap files, while leaving auto-archive to a separate memory design.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest code-history signal is ownership of both bootstrap warning handling and the Agents dashboard/file editing surface this decision would extend.
